░░ SURVIVAL PROTOCOL ░░

FIVE RULES. ONE OF THEM IS ALREADY BROKEN.

Recovered from a journal found beside a dead torch. Follow them, or become another specimen.

RULE I

NEVER ANSWER THE BREATHING

If the dark breathes your name, hold still. It only finds what moves.

RULE II

KEEP THE LIGHT ALIVE

Darkness is a door. The moment your torch dies, something steps through it.

RULE III

NEVER MEET THE EYE

Its gaze is a lock. Break it, and you will never close again.

RULE IV

DO NOT RUN UPWARD

Every tunnel bends back to the thing you are running from.

RULE V

SILENCE IS NOT SAFE

When the caves go quiet, it is already standing beside you.

H O L L O W F I L E S

SIX LOGS SURVIVED — SIX NAMES DID NOT

CLEARANCE: LEVEL 4 // DECLASSIFIED
LOG 01 / RECOVERED AUDIO (TAPE 04:12:07)

THE FIRST SILENCE

“Fourteen minutes of breathing pass before the first word. The word is never repeated. Slowed to half speed, a second voice speaks underneath it, from further away, using the same mouth — and the mouth is still open.”

LOG 02 / SPECIMEN NOTE (WARD 6)

ONE EYE, ALWAYS OPEN

“The specimen never has to turn its head. The eye finds the warmest thing in the room and stays on it. Every keeper wrote the same detail into the file: it blinked only when they stopped moving.”

LOG 03 / PERSONNEL FILE (SIX NAMES)

SIX WERE REAL

“Six names were written into this record. Six were real people, and their fear was not simulated.”

LOG 04 / SURVEY (DEPTH UNKNOWN)

THE MAP THAT WAS NEVER DRAWN

“Survey teams came back with matching sketches of corridors that do not connect.”

LOG 05 / SOURCE MATERIAL (SEALED) LOCKED UNTIL PURCHASE

NOTHING HERE IS DELETED

“The true events remain locked until official game release.”

LOG 06 / INCOMING SIGNAL (CARRIER LOST)

THE VOICE ON THE OTHER END

“Signal transmission recorded from deep within the cave.”
